params.query: company announces layoffs workforce reduction May 2026

queries.rationale: Broad semantic sweep of news category for top-of-funnel discovery of any 2026 layoff announcement in the freshness window. Highest-recall query — anchors the run.

params.query: tech company job cuts headcount reduction announcement late May 2026

queries.rationale: Tech-sector tilt on the broad slice — captures the dominant layoff cohort (tech/ai) and uses different phrasing to surface non-overlapping Exa results.

params.query: CEO statement letter to employees layoffs job cuts 2026

queries.rationale: Targets tier-1 official source (CEO letters / company blog posts) which the schema prefers for layoff_count, reason_excerpt, ceo_name fields. Authoritative-source rule favors these.

params.query: CEO message announcement workforce restructuring May 2026

queries.rationale: Company-category variant — Exa's company category surfaces corporate domains directly, ideal for official_statement_url. Pairs with q03 for breadth on tier-1 sources.
Authoritative WARN Act filings give exact layoff_count and warn_filing_url. State labor sites and aggregators report these — high signal-to-noise for US tier-1 evidence.

params.query: SEC 8-K filing workforce reduction restructuring charges May 2026

queries.rationale: 8-K filings populate sec_filing_url and provide hard layoff numbers + restructuring charges. Publicly-traded companies must disclose material workforce actions.

params.query: AI automation layoffs restructuring replacing workers 2026

queries.rationale: Captures the dominant 2026 reason_stated bucket (ai-restructuring). Surfaces companies explicitly citing AI as the driver — important for reason_excerpt enrichment.

params.query: internal memo leaked layoffs job cuts employees email 2026

queries.rationale: Internal memos leaked to press often precede official statements and carry rich reason_excerpt + affected_teams detail. Schema-aligned for partially-executed status.

params.query: (layoffs OR "job cuts" OR "workforce reduction") -filter:retweets lang:en since:2026-05-12 until:2026-05-26

queries.rationale: Primary social-official sweep — broad English-language tweets in the freshness window minus retweets. Surfaces CEO posts, company accounts, and reporter scoops for official_statement_url and social_signal.

params.query: ("we are laying off" OR "reducing our workforce" OR "difficult decision") -filter:retweets lang:en since:2026-05-12 until:2026-05-26

queries.rationale: First-person phrasings characteristic of CEO/founder posts on X. README explicitly designates X for official CEO/company announcements — this is the highest-signal slice for that role.

params.query: (layoffs OR "laid off") (CEO OR founder OR "our team") -filter:retweets lang:en since:2026-05-12 until:2026-05-26

queries.rationale: Top-ranked variant filtered to CEO/founder/team context — leverages engagement signal to surface the most-discussed announcements (good for tier-1 prioritization).

params.query: (layoffs OR "job cuts") (AI OR automation OR "replaced by AI") -filter:retweets lang:en since:2026-05-12 until:2026-05-26

queries.rationale: Cross-slice: social channel × ai-restructure reason. Captures public reaction + employee posts citing AI-driven cuts, feeding social_signal and reason_stated.
